Detail: Joint in-vitro transporter/pathway/combination PD model: ABCB1 efflux -> intracellular DOX -> cleaved PARP -> viability, with p-S6 as parallel PI3K/mTOR target engagement.
Figure 5 viability; Figure 1 DOX resistance curves.
Figure 4C p-S6 and Figure 6 cleaved PARP are image-derived relative estimates; Figure 2/3 fluorescence histograms should be used qualitatively unless raw FCS/MFI data are obtained.
The paper contains no animal tumour response. Do not infer tumour-growth inhibition from cell viability.
All plotted values are approximate visual digitizations. Western-blot estimates are ordinal/semi-quantitative and should receive wide observation error.
Durrant et al. BBA Gen Subjects 2020; DOI 10.1016/j.bbagen.2020.129556; nihms-1561688.pdf
